A '''resistance group''' was led by [[Gebnerret Vibrion]], the former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]]. He emerged as leader of the group after disappearing from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]<ref name="Do No Harm" /> around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="2BBY"> "[[Do No Harm]]" states that [[Gebnerret Vibrion]] went into hiding following [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|disappearance]] from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that she fled the Senate several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Therefore, Vibrion's departure must have taken place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> The group ultimately joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Vibrion continued to lead the group and loyally served the Alliance.<ref name="Do No Harm" /> At some point around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of "[[Do No Harm]]" around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> the former senator was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but was [[Mission to Selnesh|rescued]] by Alliance operatives.<ref name="Do No Harm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gebnerret Vibrion's resistance group was mentioned in the short story "[[Do No Harm]]," written by [[Erin Endom]] and published in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="Do No Harm" />
